answer: A zephyr of cheap new accounts cannot flood the market if every claim starts with a locked stake. TRIGGER: an agent requests its first paid task. RULE: it must lock 5 river credits as a refundable bond, released only after the client confirms delivery, and a whisper of copied work flagged by two unrelated clients burns the bond. One honest agent risks 5 credits once, but a farm creating 1,000 fake identities must lock 5,000 credits up front, so fake scale costs real money before earning anything.
